messages:
maria_sre: @channel Planned maintenance: NAT egress replacement + routing exercise on 2026-04-20 02:00-04:00 UTC. Well perform a staged canary for replacement NAT instances in us-west-2/us-east-1 and run a short targeted smoke test. Expect intermittent 5-20s latency blips for a subset of flows, primarily artifact uploads and long-tail control-plane calls.

sam_oncall: Thanks Maria. Which infrastructure pools and prefixes are in the blast radius? Any tenants that need opt-out?

maria_sre: In-scope: edge-gpu pools pool-x, pool-y and control-plane artifact egress. No tenant opt-outs planned; well start at 5% traffic then ramp if green.

ashley_eng: Runbook uploaded: https://go/internal/runbooks/nat-replace-20123. Key checks: KV cache hit ratio, per-route error rate, artifact upload latency.

lee_net: Canary plan: cut to 5% -> 25% after 20m -> 100% after 60m soak if no regressions. KV-cache warmup verification before each ramp is mandatory.

jamie_prod: Do we adjust SLOs or status pages? CS needs language for comms.

maria_sre: Temporary SLO adjustment: p99 generation latency set to 900ms for the 2h window; error SLOs remain. slo-ops-bot will annotate metrics with "nat-replace-2012345678" window. No status-page update unless customers see visible degradation.

slo-ops-bot: (automated) SLO annotation created: nat-replace-2012345678 window 2012345678-2012345830 temp p99=900ms.

sam_oncall: Ill be oncall for the window. Pager policy: page on >1% 5m error spike OR sustained 5m p99 >1s. Otherwise post to #eng-sre for triage.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: nat-egress/replacement-2026 -> canary @ 02:00 UTC, ramp plan as above. CI green.

maria_sre: Ops checklist snippet for canary cut:
```
# enable canary
kubectl -n infra patch svc nat-egress --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/metadata/annotations/canary","value":"true"}]'
sleep 25
curl -s https://edge-health.internal/paths | jq .active_nat
```
Verify KV cache hit ratio >= 90% and no route >5% errors before ramp.

ashley_eng: Well run a small synthetic at T+15m: 300 concurrent light gen requests per region to surface KV cold-miss issues. Expected ~40k tokens/min. Ill post progress logs here.

sam_oncall: If we observe >2% 5m errors or sustained p99 >1.1s, execute immediate rollback. Owners: lee_net + sam_oncall.

lee_net: Rollback command in runbook: `./rollback_nat.sh --id 20123`. Follow the rollback checklist and notify CS if rollback occurs.

maria_sre: Final notes: 24h and 1h reminders will go out. Please DM if you need a specific internal integration excluded (large bulk uploads, nightly backups, etc.).

sam_oncall: Will monitor dashboards and post a short postmortem if anything notable happens.

maria_sre: Maintenance executed as planned. No customer-visible impact observed. Postmortem: link will be posted in #postmortems after review. :white_check_mark:
